name: Photo Studio
description: Take beautiful screenshots: a free camera, freeze the whole scene, pose anyone, portrait and square photos, looks and lights, hide anything the game's photo screen can hide — and ReShade.
author: Stellar

media.caption: The Photo Studio panel next to a frozen boss fight — the free camera orbits anyone you pick.
A posed group photo taken with Photo Studio.
Portrait photos are drawn in the tall shape at full detail, not cropped.

added: The Hide list now matches the game's own photo screen: Me, My own Spirit Echo, Other adventurers, Non-players, Enemy, Weapon, Friends, Party, Guild, Collectible and Other Spirit Echo.
Friends, Party and Guild really hide those players, even while other adventurers stay visible. A hidden group always wins, but party members stay while you show your party.
Weapon now hides every player's weapon, not only yours.
A Field of view slider in the Look tab, and keys for the free camera: ] zooms in, [ zooms out (hold to keep going), backslash resets. The keys are shown on screen.
changed: Closing is clearer: the – button shrinks the panel to the small strip, and ✕ closes Photo Studio fully. If the free camera, a frozen scene, posed people, lamps or hides are still on, it asks first and lists what will end.
When Photo Studio is closed, the scene and camera pills show the key that opens it again.
Your 1.6.0 hide settings carry over to the new list.
removed: The Stellar overlay switch in the Hide list. It hid the Photo Studio panel itself; Ctrl+F10 still hides everything.

dependencies.name: ReShade (add-on build)
dependencies.notice: ReShade's add-on build is meant for single-player games or games without anti-cheat. Blue Protocol has no anti-cheat today; use it at your own discretion.

dependencies.name: Microsoft shader compiler (for Proton / Linux)
dependencies.description: Lets ReShade compile every effect when the game runs under Proton. Windows already has it.
